title: Prison of Anemas

buildingCutout.basis: The modeled Anemas wall range and paired towers only.

terrainReference.basis: Ground in front of the outer masonry, beyond the mapped projecting section.

mapIdentity.provider: The mapped Anemas attraction and surviving Blachernae fortification line, reconciled with the original 1899 measured archaeological plan.

identities.name: Prison of Anemas
identities.planCredit: Hanford W. Edson, as credited in Alexander van Millingen’s 1899 survey

mapIdentity.scope: Mapped wall offsets, the projecting 28 m twin-tower front, and the surveyed 14-compartment retaining range on the Blachernae terrace.

note: The Edson plan and 1899 survey give the lengths, north and south tower envelopes, wall height and gallery spacing. Exterior plates show rocky crowns, bands of brickwork, projecting columns, buttresses and tall openings.
